title: EncryptedAttachment
description: A file a note carries (protocol draft, section 5): where its encrypted blob is, and what opens it. Sealed with AES-256-GCM under a fresh key; contentHash is SHA-256 of the plaintext; size is the plaintext's length. Binary values are base64url without padding. Unknown terms are ignored.

mediaType.description: A label from the file name; nothing checks it against the contents.

name.description: The file's name as the sender gave it. Readers save it under a safe base name.

blobToken.description: The capability presented in the Blob-Token header to fetch the blob; the server keeps only its hash.
